convention.bearing: Degrees clockwise from BNG grid north; axis bearings modulo 180
convention.yaw: THREE positive Y yaw decreases bearing; unrotated XY wheel has plan bearing 90, so wheelYaw=90-bearing; unrotated pitch long axis Z has bearing 0 modulo180, so pitchYaw=-bearing modulo180
convention.projection: Same proj4 EPSG:27700 definition and projected Trafalgar origin as src/main.js; do not use stale fixed-origin registry comment
convention.accuracy: Reported decimals expose reproducible calculation, not survey accuracy. OSM geometry is mapped evidence.

landmarks.proposal: Build unrotated wheel, spokes, capsules, axle and supports in one local frame; apply Y yaw once. Place hub above mapped wheel centre, not bbox centre of retained support footprint. Local +Z support side then points east, towards land.
Rotate pitch, markings, floor/opening and seating long axis from N/S to measured E/W. Preserve global outer outline. Arch already spans E/W on north side: do not rotate it by the pitch quarter-turn.
landmarks.archCaveat: OSM arch tags explicitly say source=geotagged photos of the feet + artistic guesswork; do not treat the curved arch outline as precise surveyed geometry.
landmarks.archFacts: North stand, 315m span, 133m high, as stated by stadium operator.

landmarks.proposal: Existing N/S alignment is close; apply +0.329884 degrees Y yaw to pitch/markings and align centres. Preserve retained footprint. No quarter-turn.

Place chimneys at mapped centres and orient crown boilerhouse/roof along their ~11.3 degree NNE axis. Current spacing about136m across footprint should be about49m across chimney rows; rotation alone will not correct it. Retain body footprint orientation.
Map west tower centres directly and orient crown frame +7.898815 degrees Y from current cardinal layout. Dome is axisymmetric but its centre should follow mapped dome. Retain body footprint.

Use separate mapped tower centres and wall bearings, approximately -5 and -5.65 degrees Y yaw. Elizabeth is currently ~8.8m too far south. Rotate clock faces with their tower. Four-sided spire also needs pi/4 primitive phase to align square edges with tower stage. Preserve palace outline, which is not one rigid rectangle.

One Canada pyramid currently cardinal; add about -8.3 degrees Y yaw to square roof frame. Floor bands on ALL three towers should derive from their own retained outlines or own oriented frames, not world-axis bbox plates. Do not rotate actual source bodies or apply One Canada angle blindly to neighbours.
No plan-yaw correction: body, taper and sampled crown ribs all use actual retained polygon vertices, preserving irregular plan orientation. A scalar guessed yaw would rotate correct geometry.

No body-yaw correction: lathe is axisymmetric and retained base outline has map orientation. Helical lattice has arbitrary rotational phase but no evidence-grounded directional correction established.
No plan-yaw correction to current axisymmetric cylinders/rings. Base neighbours retain their own source footprints. Any later directional antennas need separate evidence.

Dome is axisymmetric. Twelve yellow masts have mapped phase -7.9509 degrees modulo30 and radius about107m. Current phase0/radius119.36m is wrong. Prefer exact node positions and connect cables radially from centre; alternatively apply +7.9509 degrees Y yaw to mast/cable frame and adjust radius.
